name: data effects
description: A mechanism in AI applications where larger proprietary datasets expand what a product can do, not just how well it does it, strengthening defensibility and scale advantages.

edges.quote: For the application layer of AI, the change will come in the form of strengthening data effects, where the larger and more proprietary the dataset, the more value a product can deliver.
It’s a race to aggregate as much data and as many completed jobs as possible to enable a product that can do more work at higher accuracy and lower cost.
